scope: Fixed thirteen-variant evidence coverage rubric with research effort on the four German variants.
primary_definition: Only independently inspected wartime/period source evidence, including scans reproduced by websites, with deductions for nonmatching specimens, untested operating points or design rather than measured figures. Published original source without measured numeric applicable data receives only limited qualitative coverage.
augmented_definition: Primary plus explicitly attributed historical-secondary findings, same-variant but different-specimen comparisons and transparent physical derivations confined to their stated assumptions. Modern game flight models are cross-checks, NOT historical flight-test measurements. Categories remain capped; no inference can manufacture source-matched measured CAS or sustained-turn data.
score_policy: Expert-judgment evidence-coverage checklist, 0..100 points. Incremental scores are conservative; recovering a citation or identifying a report without its numbers does not itself close the missing-performance category. Reprint is same original source, not another independent measurement. Two lanes are not probabilities and may remain below target. Achieving 80 is an ambition, NOT a release gate override.

variants.label: Fw 190 D-9 210002
variants.credit: Nr. 1 identifies separate 4100 kg level-flight and 4300 kg climb starts, and adds the climb curve, inlet-flap trial, and bounded as-delivered Eltron correction. variants.label: Bf 109 F-4 DB601E
variants.credit: The 1941 Messerschmitt sheet supplies full and landing loadings and climb times. Original Rechlin pages add a separate timed climb and a combat-speed comparison. The 1943 factory sheet adds a landing lift coefficient and a high-speed drag reference with unknown test method. Earlier F and hybrid data support limited augmented comparisons.
variants.next: Inspect BArch RL 3/6207 and NASM A.I.2(g) 2076 for landing flap settings, recorded stall events and correction charts. Keep F-2 and F prototypes separate.

variants.label: Bf109G-2 DB605A (research intake)
variants.credit: The G-2 Soviet handling report connects weighed takeoff mass and CG to the instrumented speed-loss campaign, with a low-speed trace, slat speeds and neutral-point data. The June 1943 service manual and the Soviet trim-run caption establish separate documented settings. WNF individual flights add a surface-finish comparison with known normalization pressures and unresolved engine type marks.
variants.next: Recover low-speed pitot corrections and actual stall-event masses for a clean G-2. Confirm the WNF engine serials before using those runs as installed DB 605 A power checks.
